Context: 4. Option to avail benefits

## 4. Option to avail benefits  
7. Option to avail benefits on death or invalidation or disability of Subscriber during service.-
- a. At the time of joining service, every Government servant must submit an option along with details of family for availing benefits under the NPS or under the Pension Rules or EOP Rules in the event of his death or boarding out on account of disablement or retirement on invalidation.
